about: Fictional job ads written for this evaluation. Gold labels say what a careful human reader would record from the ad. Conventions: a single salary figure is min = max; 'up to X' is min null, max X; 'from X' is min X, max null; monthly figures are annualised x12 (period year) because the record has no month period; bonuses, commission and super amounts are not salary; when an ad states several work-rights constraints the gold is the most restrictive one (clearance > citizen_or_pr > no_sponsorship > right_to_work) and a note says so; seniority is read from the whole ad, not only the title.

job.title: Graduate Data Analyst
job.description: About the role Join our analytics team in the Sydney CBD. You will work in the office three days a week and from home two days a week. What you will do: build weekly dashboards, clean meter data and present findings to operations. Requirements: a degree in a quantitative field; SQL and Python. Australian citizenship or permanent residency is required for this role. Salary $75,000 - $82,000 plus superannuation.
